visual.name: bfusionVarianceDriverTree
visual.description: Decomposition tree rooted on any additive measure or A minus B pair chosen inside the visual. Auto-expands the worst path, folds the long tail, and explains the drivers with findings and actions.

dataRoles.name: hierarchy
dataRoles.description: Up to 4 levels, e.g. Portfolio > Program > Project > Cost category. All levels load at once; expand nodes inside the visual.

dataRoles.name: period
dataRoles.description: Date or month column for the MoM KPI. Tree values stay the total; MoM compares the latest period with the previous one.

dataRoles.name: measures
dataRoles.description: Additive amounts (€, hours). Each becomes a selectable root inside the visual. Define A − B pairs under Format > Root.

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Extra measures shown on hover only.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

mode.description: Surface theme for the visual chrome. Auto follows the report theme's background.

background.description: Custom mode only. Plot and root background.

surface.description: Custom mode only. Header, toolbar, panels, tiles and tooltips.

textColor.description: Custom mode only. Primary text colour.

mutedColor.description: Custom mode only. Labels, captions and axis text.

ruleColor.description: Custom mode only. Separators, tile borders and axis lines.

defaultRoot.description: Root label to select when the visual loads. Empty = first measure.

variancePairs.description: Semicolon-separated pairs of measure names, e.g. Actual-Budget;EAC-Budget.

ratioMeasures.description: Semicolon-separated measure names that must not be decomposed (ratios, indexes).

inferBadDirection.displayName: Infer bad sign from root name
inferBadDirection.description: Reads a name like 'Budget vs Actuals Variance' as Budget − Actuals and sets the bad sign for a cost. Overrides and the settings above win.

badDirectionOverrides.description: Per root label, e.g. VAC=negative;Actual − Budget=positive.

paretoPct.description: Children covering this share of the parent stay visible; the rest fold into Other.

orientation.description: Horizontal grows left to right; vertical grows top to bottom.

showMom.description: Adds a MoM line to every card when a Period column is bound.

showVarPct.description: Variance as a share of the budget (or of the actual) beside the share of parent, when those measures are bound.

showTrend.description: A small line of the root value by period on every card when a Period column with three or more buckets is bound.

wheelZoom.description: On: the wheel zooms the tree under the pointer and dragging pans. Off: the wheel scrolls and Ctrl + wheel zooms.

cardMeasures.description: Semicolon-separated measure display names. Empty = every bound measure except the ones forming the current root.

method.description: How the cards worth looking at are chosen.

sensitivity.description: Pareto / Share / Momentum: percent. Outlier: sigma multiplier (1.5–3 is typical).

direction.description: Which side of the bad sign can be marked. Momentum filters on the movement; the colour follows the card.

enumeration.displayName: Auto (adverse when a bad sign is set)

maxMarks.description: How many cards may carry the pictogram. 0 = no limit.

colorAdverse.description: Colour of the mark on a card sitting on the bad side of the ledger.

colorNeutral.description: Colour of the mark on every other marked card.

showQuestions.description: A row of questions (where do I start, what is hiding, is it getting worse...) that answers from the numbers and rings the nodes involved.

showDrivers.description: The five leaves that move the scope most, ranked with a running share.

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
